info.name: Set one or more key-value pairs in key-value collection

params.name: fabric
params.description: The name of the fabric.

params.name: collection
params.description: The name of the key-value collection

items.docs:
Set one or more key-value pairs in key-value collection.

If the input is an array of objects, then key-value pairs are created in a batch.

If the key does not exist, then the key-value pairs are created. Otherwise, the entry for the key is updated.

Specify expiration in UTC timestamp.
